name: video
title: Video Player
description: Plays SD and HTTP(S) video/music with FFmpeg: H.264, MPEG-4, MJPEG, VP8, MSMPEG4v2 and Theora, plus experimental HEVC, VP9 and AV1; AAC, MP3, Opus, Vorbis and PCM audio.
author: The FFmpeg developers; PAX port
about: A small video player built on FFmpeg 7.1 (libavformat, libavcodec, libswresample; LGPL configuration, no GPL parts). Pick a file from /sd/videos/ or /sd/, type an http:// or https:// address on a USB keyboard, or let another app hand one over (NetSurf opens video and sound links here and gets its page back when you quit). MSMPEG4v2 and Theora are included; HEVC, VP9 and AV1 (libaom) are experimental software decoders and are not promises of real-time playback. Decoding is plain software on the ESP32-P4's two cores, so keep to about 480p: H.264 up to 640x360 or 854x480 plays best; bigger files are shown at half size and drop frames. Sound is the clock: pictures that fall behind are skipped, and the decoder takes shortcuts until it catches up. Streams over https:// use the loader's TLS, which checks certificates against the firmware's bundle; seeking in them uses HTTP Range requests, with a 4 MB read-ahead buffer.

Touch: tap the bar to seek, the middle to pause
Touch: < Back (top left) leaves the video
A, Space or Enter: pause / play
Left / Right, L / R: seek 10 s back / forward
Up / Down: seek 1 minute forward / back
Y or O: controls on / off
[ and ]: move the sound 50 ms earlier / later
B or Esc: back to the list (or to the app that opened it)
Menu held 3 s: quit to the launcher
File list: D-pad and A, or tap; type to enter a URL
